Cancellation preserves existing real-failure and signal pause behavior, validates in-flight samples, and discloses an already-running Ask.
Soak pause receipts separate HTTP request completion from strict confirmation of successful source cleanup.
deploymentLimits: No runtime services, camera sources, simulator state, model requests, GPU jobs, containers, images, or deployments were changed or started during this fast pass.
Controller source changes require a future authorized service restart to affect the running controller; none was performed.
Launcher and soak source changes affect later invocations, not processes already running.
No completed integrated endurance qualification is claimed; the user stopped the long observers.
The saved 20 GiB VSS guard is unchanged; only the earlier user-authorized Isaac-specific 23 GiB floor remains disabled.
A cancel marker is cooperative and cannot retract an already-submitted Ask; pending requests may finish.
No scene content was edited, no legacy Gaussian rendering was performed, and the two-camera limit is unchanged.
